features.title: Reads the accessibility tree
features.what: Reads a desktop app's accessibility tree and returns it as JSON.
features.evidence_quote: It reads the accessibility tree of a desktop app and returns it as JSON

features.title: A ref for every element
features.what: Each element the agent can act on gets a ref.
features.evidence_quote: with a ref for every element the agent can act on

features.title: Stale refs fail safely
features.what: A changed UI returns STALE_REF, so the agent takes a new snapshot.
features.evidence_quote: returns `STALE_REF` or `AMBIGUOUS_TARGET`: take a new snapshot and use its refs.

features.title: One npm command
features.what: Installs globally with one npm command.

features.title: Same loop on three desktops
features.what: The same loop runs on macOS, Windows and Linux.
features.evidence_quote: on macOS, Windows, and Linux through the OS accessibility tree

risks.text: A changed screen makes an old ref fail with STALE_REF, so the agent must snapshot again
